notes.title: Race in the 2025 FAI Spire e-Drone Racing World Cup!
notes.content: [h3]🗼 Qualifications are open for the 2025 FAI Spire event! 🗼[/h3][p]Qualifications are now open for the 2025 FAI Spire e-Drone Racing World Cup! Race and try to get the best qualification laptimes for this event, happening on Saturday 4th October, at 13:00UTC![/p][p][url="https://ereadrone.com/tournament/20"]Register here to the FAI Spire Event[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]The SPIRE track, designed by EreaDrone[/h3][p]A blue zone... a red zone... and exciting racing all throughout! [/p][p]Try out this track designed by the EreaDrone team. We're looking for feedback onn this track, so don't hesitate to tell us what you think of this track, here or on our [url="https://ereadrone.com/discord"]official Discord server[/url]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41843755/0dc667fbdb328e86325f56461909913317f7664d.png"][/img][/p][h3]🎁 Announcing Rewards for FAI events 🔓[/h3][p]Just like for EreaDrone Challengers events, all participants who have submitted at least 1 qualification laptime will receive a profile banner and player title to display in in-game and the webiste, in leaderboards or anywhere else! Of course, winners and finalists get exclusive banners and titles as well.[/p][p]We're working to bring you more in-game and out-of-game rewards for you to enjoy![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41843755/a9076aee7221bbf474abdc02b493ed687e2dd73d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]See you![/p]

notes.title: Optimization Update (and annoucing the Physics Update)
notes.content: [p][b]Hi Pilots![/b][/p][p align="justify"]Here’s a small update, mostly centred on [b]performance optimization[/b]. We hope you like it, and it should fix some problems if you have any. We would like to remind you that the [url="https://ereadrone.com/tournament/18"]registrations are still open to the second event of the 2025 FAI eDRWC[/url], so sign up now if you haven’t already! Also…[/p][p][/p][h3]⏰[b]ANNOUNCING THE CHALLENGERS LEAGUE[/b]⏰[/h3][p]We are now running a new series of competitive events: the EreaDrone Challengers League. Read more about it, and [url="https://ereadrone.com/challengers"]sign up here[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔜COMING SOON : ⚖️[i]PHYSICS UPDATE✨[/i][/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Releasing soon, we are announcing the often-requested [b][i]Physics Update[/i][/b]! It will [b]overhaul physics[/b], give you more options to tweak them, including a [b]gravity slider[/b], and will include an [b]in-game guide[/b] to explain what all those confusing sliders mean to help you get the physics that suit you best. Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]But before that, here’s the changelog for the current update:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🆕 NEW FEATURES 🆕[/b] [/h2][p][/p][h3]🌄DLSS 3.7, FSR 3.1, and XeSS 2.1 Support:[/h3][p]You can now turn on your AI upscaler of choice, which lets you enjoy higher frame-rates and better visuals. They are available to choose from in the Anti-aliasing option.[/p][p][/p][h3]🖼️Import an image in the Track Editor:[/h3][p align="justify"]You can now import [i]any image[/i] into the track editor and move it around/scale it as you want. This can be helpful to reproduce any real track layout, if you have a picture of it. This is only to help you build a track, and it will not show up once you decide to publish the track.[/p][p][/p][h3]📊Improved Drone Interpolation:[/h3][p align="justify"]In Multiplayer, drones of other players were often stuttery and distracting. With this new system, they should now fly smoothly and be accurate to how other players fly them at all times.[/p][p][/p][h3]🌬️Ground Hovering FX:[/h3][p align="justify"]In Multiplayer, you can now see some visual effects of the drones hovering over the ground. This is tied to the [i]Volumetric Clouds[/i] setting, so you can turn it on/off that way.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h2][b]👀AVAILABLE FEATURES 🔦[/b][/h2][p align="justify"][i]Over various recent patches, we discreetly added a few features, but we never told you about them… So here’s a small list of what’s new since the Rework Update:[/i][/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]🎛️[b]High Quality Collision[/b] option. Turning this on will simulate drone collisions with the ground and obstacles more accurately. Please note that this will use more system resources.[/p][p align="justify"]🔭You can now use Ctrl + scroll to [b]change your FOV in Map View Mode[/b][/p][p align="justify"]🏷️You can [b]hide other players’ names in Multiplayer[/b] (Options -> Display others’ names). We know this is often requested, and it's already in the game![/p][p]  [/p][p][/p][h2][b]📊PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS ⚙️[/b][/h2][p align="justify"][i]Here are the major changes in this update! We have major CPU and memory optimizations, and especially reduced memory allocation. This should help your game run smoother and minimize some of the issues with stutters and weird frame pacing.[/i][/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]- Better support for VRR and Low Framerate Compensation on compatible monitors[/p][p align="justify"]- Controller polling should now be more efficient[/p][p align="justify"]- Minor optimization in the Stadium environment[/p][p align="justify"]- Various bug fixes related to performance[/p][p align="justify"]- VSync and Target FPS are now independent of the quality presets[/p][p align="justify"]- Removed “Unlimited” Target Framerate option[/p][p align="justify"][i]We removed the Unlimited option because it caused lag spikes and uneven frame pacing, which do not occur when the framerate is capped. Instead, you will still have the option to choose a max framerate up to what your monitor can support, so your input latency will not be affected.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️BUG FIXES 🔧[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]⚠️Major : [/h3][p align="justify"]- Fixed missing Game Ending sequence and Spawn Selection screen in certain scenarios[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed occasional fatal game crash related to the initialisation of drone physics[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed Local Server crashing because the ports were not available[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed Tutorial mode not starting, causing the player to be stuck in the lobby settings without the start button[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed alternative fonts not working, making some non-Latin (especially Chinese, Korean, and Japanese) characters into squares[/p][p align="justify"]- Removed a 3rd Party tool that was sometimes wrongly detected as malware by some antivirus software[/p][p][/p][h3]🔎Minor:[/h3][p align="justify"]- Various security and networking fixes[/p][p align="justify"]- Various visual fixes[/p][p align="justify"]- Various fixes related to controllers and input[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed the mouse cursor never becoming invisible in certain cases[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed drones stuttering in spectator mode[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed issue where drones were locked when joining a lobby after the lobby already started[/p][p align="justify"]- Various bug fixes related to events[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed Drone Collision detection for High-Quality Collision setting, sometimes not giving back adequate control[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed a bug where localized text inside buttons was not updating when changing locale/language[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed game blocking exception when the droneprofile.ed file is corrupted[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed the Replay reader playing too quickly[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed the wrong font in the Game Mode Selection screen[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed bloom settings not being applied everywhere, and made bloom stronger[/p][p align="justify"]- General updates to packages and game components[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]And that’s it![/p][p][/p][p align="right"]- The EreaDrone Team[/p]

notes.title: The Rework Update is finally live
notes.content:
[p][b]Dear EreaDrone Community,[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been away since the end of last year’s e-Drone season, but don’t worry, we’ve been cooking! We’re finally back and have been hard at work behind the scenes to make EreaDrone bigger and better. The changes we have made are mostly technical, but we have a few cool new features to showcase as well.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]A Big, Technical Update[/h3][p]This update is quite big, but we can assure you it’s worth it. We have done a LOT of changes in the background of the game, to make it run better and allow us to do more in the future. There's a lot to download, but don’t worry: the game will now take LESS space on your drive than before, about 7 GB less in fact. The game should also run better in general and use fewer system resources. We have also added a few Quality-of-Life features in the UI. Although it's not very flashy, you can now enjoy a better drone-flying experience! [/p][p][/p][p]All those big changes are mostly in the background, but here’s some more foreground stuff.[/p][p][/p][h3]2025 World Games Official Track[/h3][p]For all those participating in the 2025 World Games in Chengdu this year, we are excited to host the official simulator track, available with this update. Fly and train on the official peculiarly-shaped track, and race your way to victory![/p][p]The track unlocks on June 27th at 14:00 CET (20:00 CST, 8 AM EDT, 15:00 AST, 21:00 JST)[/p][p]To access it in-game, search for “[i]The World Games 2025[/i]” in the track selection once it unlocks.[/p][p][/p][h3]VR Mode \[Beta][/h3][p]We have now added VR support to the Track Editor and select Environments, currently in Beta. In this mode, you can fly your drone as if you were right there on the track, and use it while building your track to get a real sense of scale and how the track feels. Feel free to try it out with your VR headset![/p][p]Please note this feature is still in Beta, so don’t hesitate to report any issues you have with it.[/p][p][/p][h3]Steam Summer Sale[/h3][p]To celebrate this new update, the upcoming competitive season, and the Steam Summer Sale, we’re happy to announce that EreaDrone is running a -40% sale. Get it while you can![/p][p][/p][h3]2025 FAI e-Drone World Cup, soon?[/h3][p]We are hard at work to prepare this year’s competitive e-Drone season, including some simulator optimizations. You will hear from us very soon regarding the 2025 FAI e-Drone Racing World Cup, so stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]Warm regards,[/p][p]The EreaDrone Team[/p][p][/p][p]---[/p][p][/p][h2]Detailed Changelog:[/h2][p][/p][h3]🆕 New Features & Enhancements[/h3][list][*][p][b]The World Games[/b]: The official drone racing track of the 2025 World Games in Chengdu will be availalbe on June 27th at 14:00 CET (20:00 CST, 8 AM EDT, 15:00 AST, 21:00 JST)[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[BETA] VR mode[/b]: See the world in VR while in the Track Editor, or in game in a few select Environments [/p][/*][*][p][b]Text Chat[/b]: The Text chat is now available during the entire lobby's life, and can be seen directly in the lobby even when the game hasn't started yet[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leaderboards[/b]: Leaderboard are now available from lobbies, session settings, and escape menu directly[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better Loadings[/b]: Loading screens now displays progress instead of freezing the game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🚀 Optimisations & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Files restructuration[/b]: Game files and systems have been completely restructured, making the game take less space on the disk (40.4Go -> 33.2Go)[/p][/*][*][p][b]RAM optimisation[/b]: RAM usage has been optimised, resulting in less memory use in most situations[/p][/*][*][p][b]Engine[/b]: Upgraded Unity Engine to version 6.1[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI stability[/b]: The UI has been completely reworked behind the scenes, making it more stable and flexible[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved multiplayer[/b]: Better performance and stability for multiplayer, game server upgraded to a new version[/p][/*][*][p][b]Depth of field[/b]: Depth of field graphical option is now disabled by default in all quality presets[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better spectator mode[/b]: Spectator camera system has been improved for a better drone tracking and camera selection[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved drone collision[/b]: Drone collission behaviour has been improved in direct mode, making it more physically accurate[/p][/*][*][p][b]Environment lighting[/b]: Improved and optimised environment lighting[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localisation[/b]: Updated some localisation text[/p][/*][*][p]Many other minor optimisations and improvements [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🧹 Bug fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bugs related to the spectator camera[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue making it impossible to select a checkpoint that has never been used, after loading a track in the track editor[/p][/*][*][p]General UI & HUD fixes and harmonisation, including fixes for improper scaling on non-16:9 monitors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed terrain shaders displaying incorrectly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Drone presentation camera behaving incorrectly in some cases[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue of not being able to set someone else as the admin[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lobby settings sometimes being unavailable after pressing “Back To Lobby”[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced volume of UI sound effects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where singleplayer GameServer instances kept accumulating and were never getting removed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Field of View of the Track Editor camera being broken in certain cases[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Drone collision status sometimes not resetting after respawn[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Bloom and Depth of Field settings being swapped[/p][/*][*][p]Various other bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🧐 Known Issues:[/h3][list][*][p]In multiplayer, other pilots’ drones appear to stutter and move in a choppy way. This is only visual, and does not impact your times, but is very distracting. A fix should soon be released.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for reading![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: More Languages, Better Multiplayer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41843755/8a2e88134fc3b320f8cda6c27d0b362182d5f314.png[/img]

[b]Dear EreaDrone Community,[/b]

Exciting news for our community: [b]"EreaDrone 2023" has officially been renamed to "EreaDrone"[/b] to better reflect our ongoing commitment to continuous improvement and updates throughout the year and beyond.

We're thrilled to share our latest update, designed to enhance your flight experience with new features, improvements, and fixes.

[b]What's New:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Revamped Multiplayer System:[/b] Behind the scenes, we've entirely redeveloped the multiplayer infrastructure to ensure [b]smoother, more reliable connections[/b]—improvements you'll feel even if you don't see them.
[*][b]New Languages:[/b] Enjoy the simulator in additional languages, including [b]Spanish, German, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Russian, Ukrainian, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, and Polish[/b].
[*][b]HUD Enhancements:[/b] Easily toggle your flight HUD with 'H'. Plus, a new HUD crosshair improves targeting and flying precision.
[*][b]Elo Ratings Enhance Multiplayer:[/b] Elevate your competition with Elo ratings, now tracked in multiplayer sessions. This update brings a dynamic way to measure and display your flying prowess, adding depth to every match.
[*][b]Optimizations for Smoother Play:[/b] Experience less stutter during key moments like joining games or finishing laps.
[*][b]'Void' Environment:[/b] 'Void' is like the 'Flat' environment but has no ground. It's perfect for map creators who want to build anything they can think of, with total freedom.
[*][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] We've eliminated invisible collision issues with trees, among other minor improvements such as the issue where rate profile selections weren't saved, requiring reselection at each game launch..
[*][b]Improved Race Experience:[/b] The live race ranking system has been enhanced for a more competitive environment.
[*][b]Leaderboard Insights:[/b] View used drone profiles on the website's leaderboard for better competition analysis.
[*][b]Server Region Expansion (In Progress):[/b] We're working on introducing server regions, beginning with Europe, with the potential for Asia and America in the future.
[/list]

This update also includes various other optimizations and minor fixes aimed at refining your experience with EreaDrone.

[b]Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm![/b]

Warm regards,

The EreaDrone 2023 Team

notes.title: EreaDrone 2023: 5 months of continuous updates since its release
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41843755/d27a18b4c60740c545adb30d11297daef263b9d6.png[/img]

[b]Dear EreaDrone Community,[/b]

Five months ago, we embarked on an ambitious journey with the [b]release of EreaDrone 2023[/b]. We were met with enthusiasm and passion from the drone racing community. However, we also faced challenges, as reflected in the feedback and reviews from our initial release. Your honest opinions have been invaluable, and we've taken every word to heart.

We understand that the journey of [b]EreaDrone 2023 didn't start as smoothly as we all hoped[/b]. The issues you faced – from performance glitches to physics refinement needs – were not in line with the high standards we set for ourselves. But every challenge is an opportunity for growth, and we've been dedicated to turning your feedback into actionable improvements.

Over the past five months, [b]we have worked tirelessly to not just address these issues, but to also enhance and expand the EreaDrone experience[/b]. We've listened, learned, and evolved. Today, we are proud to present significant updates that we believe will [b]redefine your EreaDrone 2023 experience[/b].

Here's a snapshot of what we've achieved together:
[list]
[*] [b]Major Performance Upgrades[/b]: We've tackled the stuttering and FPS issues head-on, ensuring a smoother and more responsive simulation experience.
[*] [b]Enhanced Physics and Realism[/b]: Your feedback drove significant improvements in drone physics, making every flight more thrilling and true-to-life.
[*] [b]User Interface and Quality of Life Improvements[/b]: From leaderboard integrations to customizable settings, every aspect has been refined for a more intuitive and engaging experience.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes[/b]: We've squashed numerous bugs, big and small, to ensure a more stable and enjoyable game.
[*] [b]Continuous Engagement and Support[/b]: Your ongoing feedback has been our guiding light, shaping the future of EreaDrone 2023.
[/list]

[b]We are immensely grateful for your support, patience, and constructive criticism.[/b] It's because of you that EreaDrone 2023 is not just a simulator, but a growing, thriving community. Dive into the detailed changelog below to see how your suggestions have come to life. [b]Your feedback is invaluable to us[/b]; please consider sharing your thoughts and experiences with EreaDrone 2023 by [b]writing a review on Steam[/b] – it helps us immensely!

Here's to flying higher and racing faster – together!

Warm regards,

The EreaDrone 2023 Team

[hr][/hr] 

[h2]EreaDrone 2023 - Detailed changelog[/h2]

[b][color=#4CAF50]🆕 New Features & Enhancements[/color][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Physics Overhaul[/b]:
[list]
    [*]Direct Control Mode: Disable PID for quicker, more reactive drone control.
    [*]Refined Air Drag Parameters: Experience realistic low and medium-speed air resistance.
    [*]Expanded Physics Parameters: Enjoy a broader range of settings, including an expanded -100/100% air drag parameter.
    [*]Improved Air Drag Mechanics: Reduced "floaty" sensation for a more grounded flight experience.
[/list]
[*][b]In-Game Track Leaderboards[/b]: Track your rankings easily with in-game leaderboards.
[*][b]Map Editor Upgrades[/b]: Unleash your creativity with an array of new obstacles and elements.
[*][b]Dynamic Leaderboard Updates[/b]: Achieve a personal best lap time and see your new rank instantly.
[*][b]Customizable Pod Inclination[/b]: Set your pod's angle to your preference, starting at a default 5°.
[*][b]Enhanced Path Customization[/b]: Adjust the path's thickness, opacity, and distance to suit your style.
[*][b]Cloud-Independent Profile Saving[/b]: Your drone profiles are now securely stored in your EreaDrone account.
[*][b]Fisheye Camera Simulation[/b]: Experience realistic FPV with our new fisheye effect, replicating actual camera distortion.
[*][b]Additional Minor Features[/b]: Including enhancements like the new crosshair and more.
[/list]

[b][color=#FF9800]🚀 Optimizations[/color][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Smoother Gameplay[/b]: Eliminated stuttering and FPS drops for a seamless simulation experience.
[*][b]FPS Enhancement[/b]: Enjoy an overall increase in frames per second.
[*][b]Environment Optimization[/b]: Optimized natural elements like trees and bushes for better performance.
[*][b]General Performance Tweaks[/b]: Continuous improvements across all environmental aspects.
[/list]

[b][color=#F44336]🔧 Bug Fixes[/color][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Improved Stability[/b]: Significantly reduced crashes and enhanced overall game stability.
[*][b]First Gate Respawn Logic[/b]: Addressed the issue of unintentional gate triggers on respawning.
[*][b]Stable Progress Bar[/b]: Smooth, vibration-free progress tracking.
[*][b]Multiplayer Lobby Menu[/b]: Resolved the missing context menu issue.
[*][b]Correct Keyboard Prompts[/b]: Enhanced user interface with accurate keyboard prompts.
[*][b]Autofocus Correction[/b]: Reduced unintended blurring.
[*][b]Accurate Ranking System[/b]: Fixed discrepancies during and after races.
[*][b]Comprehensive Fixes[/b]: Numerous major and minor bugs addressed for an improved gaming experience.
[/list]

[b][color=#2196F3]🔜 Upcoming Features (Work in Progress)[/color][/b]

[list]
[*][b]eDrone System Integration[/b]: Get ready for events like the 2023 FAI eDrone Racing Cup, Namwon, Korea.
[*][b]More Drone Models[/b]: Expanding the fleet with a variety of new drone models.
[*][b]More Environments[/b]: Introducing more immersive and varied environments.
[*][b]More Map Editor Elements[/b]: Enhancing creativity with a wider range of map editor elements.
[*][b]Enhanced Map Editor[/b]: Soon introducing multi-select functionality for easier editing.
[*][b]Expansive Future Updates[/b]: Preparing to add numerous additional features to further enrich the EreaDrone experience.
[/list]

If you're enjoying EreaDrone 2023, we'd be grateful if you could take a moment to [b]write a review on Steam[/b]. Your support and feedback mean the world to us!

[b]Stay tuned for more updates as we continually enhance your EreaDrone 2023 experience![/b]
